categories.main_business_segments: Shenzhen Bluetrum Technology Co., Ltd. primarily engages in the research, design, and sales of wireless audio SoC chips. Its product portfolio includes Bluetooth earphone chips, Bluetooth speaker chips, smart wearable chips, wireless microphone chips, digital audio chips, toy voice chips, AIoT chips, and AI voice recognition chips. These products are widely applied in TWS Bluetooth earphones, neckband earphones, over-ear headphones, business single-side Bluetooth earphones, Bluetooth speakers, car Bluetooth audio, TV audio, smart wearables, wireless microphones, voice toys, and IoT devices.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company adopts a fabless model focusing on chip design and development, outsourcing wafer manufacturing, packaging, and testing to specialized foundries. It uses the open-source RISC-V instruction set architecture for chip development, enabling modular design and cost efficiency. Key technologies include low-power, high-performance wireless audio SoC chips, Bluetooth dual-mode baseband and RF, FM transceiver baseband and RF, audio CODEC, power management systems, and interface circuits. The company also develops advanced AI audio processing, low-latency wireless audio transmission, Bluetooth 6.0 certified chips, Wi-Fi and Bluetooth combo RF technology, and proprietary noise cancellation algorithms.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Bluetrum serves a broad range of downstream customers including major consumer electronics brands such as Xiaomi, realme, Honor, Baidu, Anker, Edifier, Philips, Nokia, Motorola, Lenovo, and TCL. Its chips are integrated into products like TWS earphones, smart speakers, smartwatches, AI earphones, wireless microphones, and IoT devices. The company targets both mid-to-high-end and cost-effective segments, expanding penetration in emerging markets and global consumer electronics sectors.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China, with a significant concentration of revenue from the South China region. It also serves other domestic regions and actively expands into emerging international markets including India and other developing countries. The company participates in global supply chains and collaborates with international brands, aiming to increase its global market share.
categories.supply_chain_position: Bluetrum operates in the midstream segment of the semiconductor supply chain as a fabless IC design company. It focuses on chip design and development while outsourcing wafer fabrication, packaging, and testing to external foundries and subcontractors. The company then sells its chip products to downstream customers such as device manufacturers and brand owners.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes continuous R&D investment in AI audio processing, low-power Bluetooth (BLE), Wi-Fi communication, audio and video codec technologies, and AI image processing. It aims to maintain leadership in low-power, high-quality audio chips and expand product lines to include Wi-Fi and video chips. Strategic initiatives include developing AI-enabled earphones, smart speakers, AI glasses, toys, and IoT devices, as well as deepening collaborations with domestic and international large model AI platforms. Talent acquisition and retention, along with building a robust innovation ecosystem, are also key focuses.
categories.revenue_model: Bluetrum generates revenue primarily through the sales of integrated circuit chips to downstream customers, including direct sales and sales via distributors. The company’s revenue is based on product shipments of various chip lines for consumer electronics and IoT applications. It does not rely on subscription or licensing models but on volume-based product sales.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Bluetrum is recognized as a leading domestic fabless IC design company specializing in wireless audio SoC chips. It holds a top position in the wireless connectivity chip market in China, consistently ranking first among wireless connection chip companies. The company has received multiple industry awards and certifications, including national-level 'Specialized and New Small Giant' and 'Manufacturing Single Champion' titles. It competes by leveraging its RISC-V based technology, comprehensive product portfolio, and cost-performance advantages against both domestic and international competitors.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, Bluetrum achieved operating revenue of approximately RMB 1.82 billion, representing a 25.72% increase year-over-year. Net profit attributable to shareholders reached RMB 300 million, up 19.23% from the previous year. The company’s net assets totaled nearly RMB 4 billion, with a steady growth trajectory supported by expanding product sales and market penetration. R&D investment accounted for about 8.92% of revenue, reflecting sustained commitment to innovation. The company maintains positive operating cash flow and has a stable financial position.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Bluetrum emphasizes high integration, small chip size, low power consumption, balanced and comprehensive performance, and competitive pricing to deliver superior cost-performance ratio products. Its use of the open-source RISC-V architecture enables flexible, modular chip designs that reduce development costs and power consumption. The company’s proprietary Bluetooth dual-mode technology, advanced AI audio algorithms, and continuous product iteration provide differentiated features such as high-quality audio, low latency, active noise cancellation, and AI capabilities. Strong customer service, broad product applicability, and extensive patent portfolio further enhance its competitive edge.
